explanation: Retrospective detector of a licensed continuation: the pole fires on the token that finishes a unit begun by the immediately preceding word or stem - the closing subword piece of a split word ('Rams|ar', 'Rams|ay', 'oficin|as', 'links|af', Devanagari fragments) or the particle/preposition that a specific content word takes ('take| up', 'taken| up', 'member| of'). The left partner, not the current token, carries the trigger: nonce completions of the same stem ('Rams|or' 0.28, 'Zimb|ars' 0.10 against 'Rams|ar' 2.26), the same particle after an unlicensed verb ('give up' 0.29 against 'taken up' 0.91) and ' of' after non-licensing nouns ('theory of' -0.01 against 'member of' 1.18) all stay below the activity line, and predictability does not account for the pole (token surprisal correlates only +0.03 with it over the 230k-token scan).
